inputs.question: Is accidental damage covered by the warranty?
outputs.answer: No, accidental damage is not covered by the warranty.
reference.answer: No. The warranty excludes accidental damage, normal wear, and misuse.

inputs.question: I opened an item and changed my mind. Can I return it after 10 days?
outputs.answer: No, you cannot return an opened item after 10 days unless it is defective or damaged on arrival. In that case, you would need to provide a photo of the defect.
reference.answer: No. Opened items may be returned within 14 days only when they are defective or damaged on arrival, with a photo of the defect.

inputs.question: When is customer support available?
outputs.answer: Customer support is available Monday to Friday, from 09:00 to 17:00 Central European Time.
reference.answer: Support is available Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 Central European Time.
